These logs are immutable test fixtures copied from the reviewed selected run
`actions-sim-build-core-sameduck-w3`. They retain SameDuck's exact per-ABI GCC
warning streams, including the compiler-scheduling order observed in that run.
Other reviewed runs exercise different event-level interleavings.
